October 19, 2026


Cameco was proud to be a sponsor of the[Empire Club of Canada](https://facebook.com/794211527098855) 's State of the Province: Our Plan to Protect Ontario in Action event this week, featuring Premier[FordNation](https://facebook.com/636279863159648) . Premier Ford’s remarks and fireside chat focused on strengthening Ontario's economy, attracting investment and building resilience in an evolving global landscape. As a long-time contributor to Ontario's nuclear industry, Cameco is proud to help power economic growth, support good jobs, and provide the fuel and technology needed for a strong, secure energy future. Thank you to the[Empire Club of Canada](https://facebook.com/794211527098855) for bringing together leaders from across government and industry for this important conversation about Ontario's future.[#EmpireClub](https://facebook.com/hashtag/EmpireClub) #Ontario[#NuclearEnergy](https://facebook.com/hashtag/NuclearEnergy)[#EnergySecurity](https://facebook.com/hashtag/EnergySecurity)
